jobs.name: ThemeCoral
jobs.prompt: Redraw this approved Roblox castle concept from the EXACT same aerial camera with the same castle layout: the outer walls with battlements and a walkway, the four round corner towers, the stone keep in the middle with its arched floors and the creatures on pedestals, the two vault doors, the gatehouse with its glowing portcullis, the spike strip and braziers in front. Keep the Roblox-engine look (stylized semi-realistic low-poly game props, smooth shading, solid color regions, night lighting). Re-theme the whole castle as a CORAL FORT from the tropical Coral Coast biome. The theme must come from PHYSICAL PROPS built onto and around the castle, not just a recolor: Sun-bleached sandstone walls crusted with barnacles and starfish. Big branching coral formations in pink, orange and teal jut out of the battlements and grow up the towers. The tower roofs are tall spiral seashell cones in pearly teal. Giant clam-shell braziers and wall sconces burn with teal flames. Strings of glowing pearls hang along the walkways, kelp-green banners with a shell emblem, a shallow tide-pool moat with glowing anemones. The themed light sources glow and cast teal-cyan light across the stonework. It should feel like an expensive, hard-earned upgrade. No text, no labels, no UI, no people.
